package.description: Highlight parts of the screen by partially hiding unneeded parts

en-US.description: Highlight parts of the screen by partially hiding unneeded parts
en-US.longDescription:
Screen Highlighter Pro - Highlight parts of the screen
Screen Highlighter allows to highlight a part of the screen by partially hiding the other parts. A shape (horizontal bar, vertical bar, rectangle, ellipse) is visible and the rest is partially hidden.
en-US.name: Screen Highlighter Pro
